results.question: How many opportunities are currently open?
results.model_sql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS open_opportunities FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'open'

results.question: List the titles of open opportunities with a deadline before 2026-12-31.
results.model_sql: SELECT title FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'open' AND deadline < '2026-12-31'

results.question: What is the total amount in USD across open opportunities?
results.model_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_usd) AS total_amount_usd FROM opportunities WHERE status = 'open'

results.question: Which funder has the most opportunities? Give the name.
results.model_sql: SELECT f.name FROM funders f JOIN opportunities o ON o.funder_id = f.id GROUP BY f.id, f.name ORDER BY COUNT(o.id) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the average amount in USD of opportunities in West Africa?
results.model_sql: SELECT AVG(amount_usd) AS average_amount_usd FROM opportunities WHERE region = 'West Africa'

results.question: Which funders are based in Kenya?
results.model_sql: SELECT id, name, type, country, focus_area, website FROM funders WHERE country = 'Kenya'

results.question: List titles of opportunities worth more than 100000 USD.
results.model_sql: SELECT title FROM opportunities WHERE amount_usd > 100000

results.question: How many applications have been submitted?
results.model_sql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS submitted_applications FROM applications WHERE submitted_on IS NOT NULL

results.question: How many opportunities are there in each region?
results.model_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS opportunity_count FROM opportunities GROUP BY region

results.question: What is the title of the opportunity with the latest deadline?
results.model_sql: SELECT title FROM opportunities WHERE deadline IS NOT NULL ORDER BY deadline DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which funders have no opportunities at all?
results.model_sql:
SELECT f.id, f.name, f.type, f.country, f.focus_area, f.website
FROM funders f
LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.funder_id = f.id
WHERE o.id IS NULL

results.question: Names of funders whose focus area is journalism.
results.model_sql: SELECT name FROM funders WHERE focus_area = 'journalism'
